byok.description: Free | you deliver through your own stored SMTP server

name: http-to-smtp

from.description: Envelope sender for this enrollment. Used as the MIME `From` when the posted payload carries no `from` of its own. Most SMTP servers require this to be an address they are willing to send as.

host.description: SMTP host for this enrollment (e.g. smtp.gmail.com, smtp.sendgrid.net, email-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com). Defaults to the platform's mailpit testing sink.

password_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding the SMTP password. Defaults to HTTP_TO_SMTP_PASSWORD (shared with the free byok channel) so an empty-params enrollment works out of the box.

port.description: SMTP port. 1025 for the mailpit testing sink, 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for implicit TLS.

tls.description: Transport security for the SMTP connection: `starttls` (upgrade on port 587), `ssl` (implicit TLS on port 465), or `none` (plaintext — testing sinks and trusted internal relays only).

to.description: Default recipient for this enrollment. Used when the posted payload carries no `to` of its own.

username_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding the SMTP username. Defaults to HTTP_TO_SMTP_USERNAME. Leave the secret empty for unauthenticated sinks.
